phases.name: Freeze and audit the baseline
phases.command: cargo run -p zerolm-policy --bin zerolm-baseline -- generate && cargo run -p zerolm-policy --bin zerolm-baseline -- check

phases.name: Neural compute engine and architecture bake-off
phases.command: cargo test --workspace && cargo run --release -p zerolm-eval --bin zerolm-bakeoff -- --check model/specs/architecture.json

phases.name: Bootstrap language interface and deterministic initialization
phases.command: cargo test -p zerolm-tokenizer -p zerolm-engine -p zerolm-runtime -p zerolm-policy

phases.name: First true online neural language model
phases.command: cargo test -p zerolm-learning -p zerolm-eval && cargo run --release -p zerolm-eval --bin zerolm-online-lm

phases.name: Weight-resident associative memory
phases.command: cargo test -p zerolm-memory -p zerolm-runtime && cargo run --release -p zerolm-eval --bin zerolm-memory

phases.name: Concepts, relations, and compositional reasoning
phases.command: cargo test -p zerolm-engine -p zerolm-reasoner && cargo run --release -p zerolm-eval --bin zerolm-reasoning

phases.name: Uniform neural engine and WSP compiler
Real-text exposure streams and reference baselines
Scalable core with compiled seed circuits (Gate A)
Deep representation learning without backpropagation (Gate B)
Reading into memory and reasoning inside the network
